summary: Full resolution of Codex Review Findings R1-R4 for DRIVE-01-F09: (R1) Chained close failure and dynamic pending permit accounting on scalar contract rejection in DriveIoExecutor, eliminating lost cleanups (DRIVE_F08_scalar_cleanup.java exit 0, full backend suite 162/162 PASS); (R2) Strict fail-closed process identity in stop_backend_dev.ps1 checking complete state schema, non-null CIM process attributes, canonical executable path, snapshot profile argument, and CreationDate delta < 3s (DRIVE_F08_stop_missing_identity.ps1 exit 0); (R3) Strict browser verification in test_live_browser_f09.cjs enforcing 1920x1080 Full HD dimensions, rejecting CDP error responses, asserting positive RVFC presentation callbacks near 3 seek targets (60s, 200s, 400s), verifying post-seek advancement > 1.5s, and verifying pause drift = 0.000s; (R4) Verified end-to-end browser UI interaction with CineBot in test_live_cinebot_browser_f09.cjs (modal open, query send, Qwen3-4B + Phase 23 LoRA inference on RTX 3050 CUDA, 6 movie recommendation cards rendered in DOM), updated DRIVE_SNAPSHOT_RUNBOOK.md with 60s Drive timeouts, saved raw backend test log (162/162 PASS), and declared Linux/JDK17 CI as PENDING remote execution.

R1_scalarContractRetention.finding: DriveIoExecutor.executeScalar swallowed failed close on forbidden AutoCloseable, losing cleanup obligations in boundary conditions.
R1_scalarContractRetention.resolution: executeScalar now attempts close immediately; on failure, dynamically acquires a pending lifecycle permit if within capacity (chargesPending=true, incrementing pendingCleanupObligations), records the failed cleanup into retainedFailedCleanups, and chains closeEx into the thrown IllegalArgumentException (both cause and suppressed). clearRetainedFailedCleanup decrements pendingCleanupObligations only when chargesPending is true.
R1_scalarContractRetention.tests: DRIVE_F08_scalar_cleanup.java (exit 0), DriveGenericMetadataReproTest (5/5 PASS), full backend suite (162/162 PASS)

R2_failClosedProcessIdentity.finding: stop_backend_dev.ps1 checked executable and creation date only when truthy/supplied, allowing missing identity attributes to reach Stop-Process.
R2_failClosedProcessIdentity.resolution: stop_backend_dev.ps1 now strictly validates state file schema requiring non-empty PID, StartTime, ExecutablePath, CommandLine, CreationDate. Re-queries live process via Get-CimInstance Win32_Process, asserts all properties are non-empty, checks canonical path equality, verifies MovieRcmApplication and snapshot profile arguments, validates CreationDate within 3s, and guards state file deletion behind confirmed termination.

R3_strictBrowserTimelineVerification.finding: test_live_browser_f08.cjs accepted hasRvfc=false fallback, warned rather than failed on non-1280 dimensions, and unresolved CDP errors.
R3_strictBrowserTimelineVerification.resolution: Implemented test_live_browser_f09.cjs with isolated profile and dynamic CDP port. Rejects CDP protocol error responses and exceptionDetails. Enforces 1920x1080 Full HD dimensions strictly. Validates RVFC decoded presentation callbacks with presentedFrames > 0 and target-near mediaTime at 3 seek points (60s, 200s, 400s), asserts continued advancement > 1.5s, and asserts pause drift = 0.000s.

R4_cinebotBrowserAndRunbookEvidence.finding: Browser CineBot UI interaction remained unproven; runbook lacked 60s Drive timeouts; Linux/JDK17 CI evidence lacked raw disclosure.
R4_cinebotBrowserAndRunbookEvidence.resolution: Implemented test_live_cinebot_browser_f09.cjs verifying end-to-end browser interaction: UI modal open, prompt typing, send dispatch, Qwen3-4B + Phase 23 LoRA inference on RTX 3050 CUDA, and rendering of 6 movie recommendation cards in DOM. Updated DRIVE_SNAPSHOT_RUNBOOK.md with 60s Drive timeouts. Published raw full backend test log (full_backend_test_f09.log). Truthfully declared Linux/JDK17 CI as PENDING remote execution.
